content.text:
The university moved from their initial position to uni_owns_option_to_licence with 12 months exclusivity. We wanted company_owns_uni_academic_use with 24 months. Let me trade: accept uni_owns_option_to_assign (stronger than option_to_licence, gives us path to full ownership) and keep 12 months exclusivity, or push for company_owns with 12 months.

I can change at most two fields. Let me move on IP to uni_owns_option_to_assign (a compromise - better than option_to_licence for us, less than company_owns) and accept the 12 months exclusivity as a trade.
